replies.body:
Hello zCombo,

There seems to be some kind of mistake. Your zCombo account will not be appealed because you were caught ban evading and further more Cozzehpvp_ was also caught ban evading and therefore he will be re-banned. Sorry for any confusion but there was an error that was made in your appeal. 

Regards,
